authoring.goal: Join every QuACK SVG to the inspected CuTe DSL kernel path, its synchronization contract, and its on-chip memory lifetime.
authoring.note: The catalog is an evidence ledger for direct LLM-authored SVGs; it is not a renderer.

kernels.role_path: CTA warps load logits and saved LSE → reconstruct probabilities and target correction → scale and store dX
kernels.synchronization_and_memory: Saved LSE removes the forward cross-CTA reduction; a logit SMEM tile is released after reconstruction while probability and broadcast state remain in registers; TMEM is unused.

kernels.architecture: CUDA cooperative CTA or CTA-cluster reduction
kernels.role_path: CTA warps load logits and metadata → compute stable row max/sum and target term → publish loss, LSE, and optional dX
kernels.synchronization_and_memory: Reduction barriers publish row or cluster partials before epilogue reads; logit and exchange SMEM live through the stable reduction and FP32 row state remains in registers; TMEM is unused.

kernels.role_path: Scheduler assigns work → TMA warp fills A/B stages → UMMA warp issues tcgen05 MMA into TMEM → epilogue warps stage and TMA-store D
kernels.synchronization_and_memory: Producer/consumer mbarriers protect A/B ring reuse from j to j+1; two TMEM accumulator stages alternate and remain distinct from C/aux SMEM and D output stages.

kernels.role_path: CTA warps acquire a tile → TMA-load A/B → ldmatrix and warp MMA accumulate in registers → TMA-store D
kernels.synchronization_and_memory: Stage ownership barriers release A/B stage j before the same SMEM slot becomes j+1; accumulators are register-resident and TMEM is not used on SM120.
visible_tokens: MAINLOOP · warp MMA j / prefetch j+1

kernels.role_path: TMA producer warps multicast A/B → WGMMA consumers issue the K loop → epilogue stages and TMA-stores D
kernels.synchronization_and_memory: Pipeline barriers gate A/B stage issue and release before j+1 reuse; WGMMA accumulators live in registers because SM90 has no TMEM.

kernels.role_path: CTA warps seed a row → perform local butterflies and optional shared exchange → scale and store the transformed row
kernels.synchronization_and_memory: sync_threads separates shared butterfly exchanges; the row-j SMEM buffer is released after the exchange and reused for j+1 while register butterflies remain live; TMEM is unused.
visible_tokens: same row buffer reused for j+1

kernels.role_path: CTA warps load partial RMS values → reduce warp and row partials → compute rsqrt and store final rstd
kernels.synchronization_and_memory: A reduction barrier makes the row total visible before broadcast; SMEM partials end after broadcast and the final scalar is register-resident; TMEM is unused.

kernels.role_path: CTA warps load Xj and dOj → reduce correction terms and form dX → emit dX plus partial dW/dB
kernels.synchronization_and_memory: Consumer waits and reduction barriers keep Xj/dOj and reduction slots live through correction; the shared stage releases before the same physical slot becomes j+1; TMEM is unused.
visible_tokens: same ring slot reused for j+1

kernels.role_path: CTA warps load X and optional residual → reduce row statistics and apply affine transform → publish stats and Y
kernels.synchronization_and_memory: Reduction exchange completes before affine consumers read statistics; X/residual SMEM persists until its final affine read while mean/rstd and fragments stay in registers; TMEM is unused.

kernels.role_path: CTA warps load indices, cos/sin, and paired X values → rotate each pair → handle the tail and store
kernels.synchronization_and_memory: The non-interleaved cp.async path uses sync_threads before paired reads; its X split tile releases after the pair read while cos/sin and rotated pairs stay in registers; TMEM is unused.

kernels.role_path: CTA warps load dY and saved Y → reduce dot(dY,Y) → apply the Jacobian and store dX
kernels.synchronization_and_memory: Exchange and a dot-ready barrier publish the scalar before dX formation; paired dY/Y SMEM remains live to that boundary while products and dot stay in registers; TMEM is unused.

kernels.architecture: CUDA cooperative CTA or CTA-cluster reduction
kernels.role_path: CTA warps load X → reduce stable row max and denominator, optionally across a cluster → normalize and store Y
kernels.synchronization_and_memory: Cluster partials pass through mbarriers before denominator use; sX and exchange SMEM live through the final reduction read while FP32 max/exp/sum remain in registers; TMEM is unused.

kernels.role_path: CTA warps seed from workspace W0 → accumulate W1…Ws-1 in deterministic order → apply the linear epilogue once and store D
kernels.synchronization_and_memory: Split ordering is the semantic dependency; one FP32 register accumulator persists across the loop, optional SMEM only stages inputs, and TMEM is unused.

kernels.role_path: CTA warps load selected gradients and indices → transform and scatter into a zero shared tile → coalesced dense-store warps publish dX
kernels.synchronization_and_memory: A cooperative barrier separates irregular scatter from dense reads; input/exchange SMEM releases at its last consumer and epilogue-owned output staging publishes dX; TMEM is unused.

kernels.role_path: CTA warps acquire values and indices → run register bitonic selection with deterministic ties → redistribute selected lanes, optionally softmax, and store
kernels.synchronization_and_memory: Warp shuffles and cooperative barriers order selection and redistribution; selected values/indices remain in registers, with only optional SMEM exchange/output staging; TMEM is unused.
visible_tokens: register compute state; TMEM only on the SM100 GEMM path
